page.overview:
Who is Theatrhythm Final Fantasy Curtain Call quotes?

In Theatrhythm Final Fantasy Curtain Call, characters will quote or paraphrase lines, usually from their games of origin, on the main menu, upon leveling up, and during battles in Versus Battle Mode. Each character in the party displays a randomized facial expression before the stage commences.
